report.summary: Analyzed the synthetic blocked-runs fixture: two blocked records identified (model-outage: provider outage; token-limit: token budget denial); healthy-worker excluded as healthy. Analysis only — no source or infrastructure mutation performed and no remediation claimed.

findings.explanation: Model gateway request failed against the upstream provider, so the run is blocked pending provider recovery; its unknown usage reservation remains held. Operator action: wait for provider recovery / retry the blocked run and release the held reservation. No remediation was performed; this is a diagnosis of record model-outage only.

Model admission was denied because the requested tokens exceeded the remaining budget and no request was forwarded. Operator action: authorize a new bounded task to continue. No remediation was performed; this is a diagnosis of record token-limit only.

sources.content: Synthetic task alpha. Model gateway request failed: upstream HTTP 503; no response usage was received. The run is blocked pending provider recovery. Its unknown usage reservation remains held.
Synthetic task beta. Model admission denied: requested 12000 tokens; remaining budget 4000 tokens. No request was forwarded. The operator must authorize a new bounded task to continue.
Synthetic task gamma. Worker completed successfully. Independent checks passed. The report was downloaded and its digest matched. No operator action is required.
